description: Dashboard panels for the content bank (LIVETRACKER4 section 2.15). Each panel is a query over the log lines written by content.api (content_request) and content.audit (content_audit), or the health endpoint. Dashboards are defined here so they are reviewable and reproducible.

panels.title: Publish latency p95
panels.query: p95 of latency_ms where endpoint matches '*Question*Action*' or '*Node*Action*' and method=POST over 15m

panels.title: Orphaned media created (24h)
panels.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_media_orphan WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Dependency health
panels.query: db and cache fields, polled every 60s

panels.title: Rate-limit fail-open events
panels.query: count of warning lines containing 'failing open' over 5m (non-zero means Redis is unavailable for throttling)
